setup: "WhatsApp Webhook (WAHA)" (webhook) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Setup value recipientPhone: Recipient phone number (E.164) (for example +15551234567). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value whatsappTemplateName: WhatsApp message template name (for example hello_world). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value whatsappPhoneNumberId: WhatsApp Business phone number id (for example 123456789012345). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value sheetName: Sheet tab name (for example Sheet1). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value spreadsheetId: Google Sheets spreadsheet id (from the sheet URL) (for example 1AbC...xyz). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value slackChannel: Slack channel the incoming webhook posted to (for example #alerts). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /leadbot-24h). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
"Notify Sales Team (Slack/Webhook)" posted through a Slack incoming webhook; it now posts with the Slack connector to the channel in slackChannel.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect slack: `cdecli credential create -n "slack" -p slack --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect whatsapp: `cdecli credential create -n "whatsapp" -p whatsapp --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
